warnings.type: Numerical preparation interest coexists with negative quantitative preference; inspect
warnings.authorReview: Her quantitative dislike is graphs and uncertain numerical evidence used to compare possibilities, plus mathematics and number puzzles. The follow-up is a specified calculation, attendance records, and checking tables so others can rely on them. That matches her stated precision and organization methods, rewritten temperature checklist, meal she has checked, and a checklist someone else could follow.
